| Q2 \Attempt any Two Parts) UNIT-1 (CO:) _ (5,5) |
(a) Identify future trends and improvements in Social Media Analytics.
How do emerging technologies like artificial intelligence and machine learning affect the
development and implementation of SMA methodologies?
(b) Describe the significance of information visualization techniques in SMA.
How do visual representations like node-link diagrams and heatmaps help with analyzing
and understanding of complex social media data?
(c) How can Social Media Analytics (SMA) turn raw social media data into actionable
insights? How does this method influence organizational decision-making?
| Q3 | (Attempt any Two Parts) _UNIT-2 (CO2)
(a) Explain the importance of random graphs in modeling network evolution.
How can random graphs help us understand the structure and dynamics of social
networks over time? Provide real-world examples of the use of random graphs in social
media analytics.
Discuss the use of online surveys in web analytics. How are online surveys planned, —
implemented, and analyzed to collect user input and insights?
Give scenarios of how online surveys are used to improve website performance and
usability.
Explain an overview of NLP techniques for micro-text analysis in social media analytics.
How does NLP algorithms extract information from short-form text data, such as social
media postings and comments?
